notes.manas-2010:p1042:b001:l006: бейпай affliction/trouble confirmed1969/2015 dictionaries https://el-sozduk.kg/beypay/; not a greeting from superficially adjacent салам (сал- first-person future).
notes.manas-2010:p1042:b001:l009: Үрүстөм Дастан retained in conventional Rustam Dastan form for the epic hero; no historical crossing asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p1042:b001:l014: Two names in an inscription retained, including future Manas crossing announced by companions; no invented inscription text.
notes.manas-2010:p1042:b001:l031: өтөк mountain hollow/clearing; not a building.
notes.manas-2010:p1042:b001:l033: бурчтан- project in angles/prominences, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/бур/. Flat summit with projecting edges retained, no perfume interpretation borrowed from next row.
notes.manas-2010:p1042:b001:l038: Between Mecca and Beijing is the epic geography; no modern geographical correction.
notes.manas-2010:p1042:b001:l041: оорук army rear/baggage camp, edition glossary1841:l039–041, not sickness.
notes.manas-2010:p1043:b001:l004: Five horse names/epithets appear though four champions next; count not normalized. Көкчебич is exact printed name, Kurong chestnut horse treated as designation.
notes.manas-2010:p1043:b001:l006: аса байла- tie horse with head drawn high, exact Yudakhin formula https://el-sozduk.kg/ас/; баймактап tether by one foot, edition glossary1834:l040. English plural feet refers to several horses, not hobbling all four legs of each.
notes.manas-2010:p1043:b001:l007: ач болот keen steel weapon rather than hungry steel literal personification; specific weapon not supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p1043:b001:l008: ак каңкы white saddle as pillow, edition glossary1833:l029–031; not cannon.
notes.manas-2010:p1043:b001:l013: Leopard and lion kept as two described dream figures, not identified with named enemies.
notes.manas-2010:p1043:b001:l021: Sixty worries is literal poetic number; no condensation to many.
notes.manas-2010:p1043:b001:l031: Young son retained despite inconsistencies with earlier marriage chronology; no name or exact age added.
notes.manas-2010:p1043:b001:l035: кезек II/III = кесек, with abusive worthless/wretched sense; Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/кезек/ and https://el-sozduk.kg/кесек/ exact кесек ит. Not queue or new proper name. Source shifts plural brothers to singular contemptuous slave; retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1043:b001:l038: Repeated worthless slave attack threat retained, with cut down not merely disagree.
notes.manas-2010:p1043:b001:l040: бадыраң темир common iron, exact proverb Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/badyran-5/; not cucumber iron. курч rendered keen steel in contrast, proverbial not metallurgical instruction.
notes.manas-2010:p1043:b001:l041: журт can be people/community or kin; maxim about someone raised apart retained without strengthening to ethnicity or universal commentary outside character speech.
notes.manas-2010:p1044:b001:l003: күнү катын co-wife, specifically mothers sharing Jakyp as husband; primaryManas encyclopedia https://el-sozduk.kg/күн/ explicitly names Chyyyrdy/Bakdoolot. Not woman named Kunu.
notes.manas-2010:p1044:b001:l005: Sloping forehead and grass-like forelock retained in ominous description; not silently replaced with generic beauty.
notes.manas-2010:p1044:b001:l010: жүзүндө literal upon her face retained, potentially physiognomic omen of future suffering, not generalized life.
notes.manas-2010:p1044:b001:l014: огой read Nogoy with lost initial н per edition introduction15:b002:l005; raw unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p1044:b001:l020: бейм as anxious conjecture, so may rather than definite future; repeated threat retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1044:b001:l025: Neck strap remains on while spyglass taken from robe; no technological modernization to binoculars.
notes.manas-2010:p1044:b001:l033: Printed Bolokbai is unmarked nominative before causative алдырган; interpreted craftsman had it brought, not Manas summoned craftsman (would require object case). Object аны refers back to spyglass provisionally; sourcing/repair versus subsequent made remains compressed and uncertain. No unmentioned lens imported.
notes.manas-2010:p1044:b001:l034: Кырымдан from Crimea retained as source geographical name; this is distinct from unresolved635 кылым кырымы gun formula.
notes.manas-2010:p1044:b001:l035: Subject of козголгон unstated; rendered set things stirring with bellows without invented earthquake.
notes.manas-2010:p1044:b001:l036: Дөөтү David, legendary smith patron; friendship is epic sacred imagery, not historical coexistence assertion.
notes.manas-2010:p1044:b001:l041: кынабына келтир- fit precisely/bring to proper form, not inserting the telescope in a sword sheath.
